preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**9 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Each number of friends N is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= 10**9 for K in Ks)
preconditions.description: Each number of slices per pizza K is within the specified range.
